description: tasks_probe: replanning (tests: replan_preview_is_exact_and_preserves_completed_steps, attempted_window_cannot_be_relabelled_by_replan, removed_action_later_execution_does_not_change_completed_task): previews only for paused runs with settled effects, the same goal/routine/request/mode, immutable completed and attempted steps and source windows, limits covering spent work, a subject bound to the exact plan and revision; replan with human evidence (wrong decision, subject, revision, missing), replay refused, steps added, removed (cancelled history) and reset, resume after replan, a removed action whose later execution does not change the completed task, and a changed binding invalidating approvals.
